extraction.Name: Louisa Colhoff
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of not wanting to pay taxes, but the Indian Agency and her farmer, told her that she would have to pay taxes on it any way, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: has never sold or mortgaged any of her allotment
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: there is about three or four years taxes against it now
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; home is established on her allotment and her husband farms her allotment; has six minor children; health is not very good; the children are all troubled with heart disease; has never received any help from the County or United States Government; document sworn November 13, 1928; note: document refers to deponent as 'she' throughout but opening statement incorrectly uses 'his' for post office address
